title: Blast Plaster
body:
Official MCT Discord Server [Here](https://discord.gg/ujY2mV9).

Assets are protected under the terms in the LICENSE_ASSETS.txt on the code repository.

![Logo](https://i.postimg.cc/JhJmNkDQ/MCT-Clear.jpg)

Make it like it never happened, tame those Blasters with Plaster!
Works like CreeperHeal but with more options!

- Can heal Creeper explosions.
- Can heal other mod Explosions like Nucleepers.
- Does not heal player created explosions (configurable).

New modes -

- #HEAL (default): blocks disappear then slowly restore + fake tossed blocks fly out
- #EJECT_DROPS: blocks gone forever, real drops with 1/3 chance per block (exactly matching vanilla creeper), otherwise fake tossed block instead (fakes exactly make up the remaining ~2/3, 100% visual coverage)
- #VISUAL_TOSS: blocks gone forever, only fake tossed blocks fly out (no real drops, no restore)

Many more configuration options.

In HEAL mode explosions are allowed to happen. Then the mod will restore blocks, trees, vegetation, and even works with Dynamic Trees.

![Mod logo](https://i.postimg.cc/Jz6ftrdm/logo-with-trowel.jpg)
*This Creeper image is a mod logo and is not in the game or mod*

You may use this mod in any modpack, and put a link back to this page as a courtesy!
